title: Even Google Calendar has a blast radius
body: In June 2019 a network configuration change intended for a small set of servers was applied to a much larger set, congesting Google's network and degrading services including YouTube and Gmail for hours. Their postmortem describes automation safeguards that have since become standard sermon material: scope checks and canaries on configuration, not only on code. Configuration is code that skips review.
source_hint: Google Cloud status and postmortem, June 2019
